description: This PHP source file defines a REST API controller class named CurrentVersionAPI, which provides endpoints to get and set the current version of the application during an upgrade process within the OrangeHRM system. It handles version retrieval from either a state container or the database, and allows updating the current version via POST requests.

classes.name: CurrentVersionAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for retrieving and updating the current version of the application during the upgrade process.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current application version, either from the StateContainer or from the database if not available in the StateContainer.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to set the current application version in the StateContainer.
